title: Deduplicate while preserving first-seen order
prompt:
In this directory, create a Python file named dedupe.py.

It must provide one function:

  dedupe(items) -> list

Requirement, in the words of the person who asked for it:

  Give me back the same list with duplicates removed, in the order they
  first appeared, and it has to cope with unhashable things like lists.

Use only the Python standard library. Do not create any other files.
